changelog:
Initial release of the factory-acceptance-test skill:

- Generates complete FAT plans or reports, including test coverage matrix, AQL sampling plans, pass/fail criteria, golden-sample handling, deviation log, and sign-off structure.
- Guides users to specify required product, spec, lot, risk, quality history, and signatories.
- Provides clear defect classification and default AQL settings per ANSI/ASQ Z1.4.
- Outputs inspection sampling tables with explicit accept/reject numbers.
- Ensures actionable, auditable acceptance with named sign-off and deviation handling.
